title: Introducing ChatGPT Health
summary: ChatGPT Health is a dedicated experience that securely connects your health data and apps, with privacy protections and a physician-informed design.
body: ChatGPT Health is a dedicated experience that securely connects your health data and apps, with privacy protections and a physician-informed design.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了ChatGPT Health，旨在通过整合健康数据与应用，提供隐私保护下的医疗辅助体验。该产品侧重于应用层面的整合与设计，而非模型技术本身的突破。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于特定垂直领域的应用发布，缺乏模型层面的技术创新细节。
